KeyTheme: Judgment on Edom and Israel's restoration
Summary: Obadiah, the shortest Old Testament book, pronounces judgment on Edom for rejoicing over and looting Jerusalem in its disaster. It promises the Day of the Lord for all nations and Israel's eventual restoration.
Themes: Judgment on pride; Day of the Lord; Israel's restoration
Purpose: To assure Judah that God will judge Edom's pride and violence and restore His people.
Outline: Judgment on Edom (1-14); Day of the Lord (15-16); Israel restored (17-21)
HistoricalContext: Issued after an attack on Jerusalem in which Edom participated, commonly linked to the Babylonian destruction in 586 BC.
